interpretation: Ordered engineering suggestions, not a statistical model ranking or independent human review; counts are nonexclusive tags across the frozen 40-image sample.
scope: Simulation-first, object/composition primitives prioritized; analytical request solvers are optional reusable secondary capabilities.

priorities.title: General finite 2D dielectric polygons
priorities.native: Glass polygonal boundary; reuse native v8 prism path/first-event observer
priorities.risk: medium-high: vertices, corner hits, medium membership
priorities.llmBurden: Three to six explicit vertices and both material indices only; no native path grammar
priorities.acceptance: One 4-vertex rectangular region with one finite ray and per-face observations; native entry/exit and TIR; invalid/self-crossing/overlap refused. A17 is a shape inspiration, not an answered original question.

priorities.title: Opaque stops, finite apertures and passive screens
priorities.risk: medium: ray sampling and visibility/spot interpretations
priorities.llmBurden: Geometrically stated blocker or aperture dimensions; no unseen stop radius
priorities.acceptance: Blocked vs unblocked native sample-ray crossings, immutable edits, detector labels and all invalid/incomplete suppression; A18 visibility remains unavailable until richer source/observer measurement.

priorities.title: Bounded source/branch event lineage
priorities.native: Native source start and incident callbacks
priorities.risk: high: native branch IDs, Fresnel truncation, source attribution
priorities.llmBurden: No authored path allowed; tracker derives events only from native rays
priorities.acceptance: One single-ray multi-face/multi-mirror scene with actual source-to-incident events; verify branching/late callbacks; never connect unrelated first events.

priorities.title: Observer and qualified apparent-image geometry
priorities.native: Existing Scene observer rendering and native detectors as distinct ideas
priorities.risk: high: virtual image inference, paraxial vs 3D apparent-depth claims
priorities.llmBurden: State observer position and explicit physical media; don't infer an emitting bubble or 3D eye
priorities.acceptance: Compare one planar and one curved surface against independent paraxial or ray-convergence oracle, retain unavailable outcome for ambiguous image formation.

priorities.title: Directional fans and true parallel beams in refractive scenes
priorities.risk: medium-high: sampling, Fresnel weak branches and source-dependent power
priorities.llmBurden: Explicit beam width/orientation/brightness and ray density separate from optics
priorities.acceptance: Controlled native beam spot/TIR tests with complete-run gates and stable variance under density; do not silently treat many single rays as continuous light.

priorities.title: Decentered and subsequently tilted thin lens trains
priorities.native: IdealLens finite endpoints support nonzero y center
priorities.risk: medium: ABCD coordinate offsets and finite aperture collisions
priorities.llmBurden: Explicit transverse lens centres and orientations as physical facts
priorities.acceptance: Two shifted ideal lenses with independent paraxial ray-direction oracle, order-invariant native build; no fake parallel source.

priorities.title: Extended objects as bounded groups of physical points
priorities.risk: medium: emitted vs nonemitting shape, image identification
priorities.llmBurden: Explicit object point/segment shape; no arbitrary samples invented as question facts
priorities.acceptance: Triangle or quadrilateral object points with qualified conditional image mapping; unchanged native per-source emission counts.

priorities.title: Microscope, telescope and simplified eye models
priorities.risk: high: angular magnification, accommodation and nearpoint/tube-length conventions
priorities.llmBurden: Physical instrument definitions and observer assumptions must be stated
priorities.acceptance: A declared simplified two-lens instrument with independently checked angular magnification and observer assumptions; preserve unavailable if conventions absent.

priorities.title: Shared-corner finite mirror sets
priorities.risk: medium: simultaneous endpoints and rays at corners
priorities.llmBurden: Explicit enclosure vertices, not four hand-tuned line segments
priorities.acceptance: Quadrilateral mirror enclosure with verified finite reflections and no fabricated image count.

priorities.title: General time functions for moving sources
priorities.risk: medium: time sampling, bounds, expression security
priorities.llmBurden: Explicit supported trajectory type and parameters; no arbitrary executable formula
priorities.acceptance: Sinusoidal axial source motion with sampled native frames, baseline hashes and independent image kinematics checks.

priorities.title: Material-index, thick lenses and immersed lenses
priorities.risk: high: curved surfaces, dispersion, exterior medium, lensmaker scope
priorities.llmBurden: Explicit radii/medium indices and physical thickness where required
priorities.acceptance: Two lenses differing only by refractive index, independently checked paraxial response, no missing shape dimensions invented.

priorities.title: Reduced prism deviation and index inverse observables
priorities.native: Existing native triangular Glass for optional forward verification
priorities.risk: low-medium: multiple branches and grazing critical boundaries
priorities.llmBurden: Only refracting angle, incidence/deviation/index facts supplied; no synthetic native coordinates
priorities.acceptance: Prism angular constraints with separate symbolic/conditional provenance; no trial of JEE original answers during coding.

priorities.title: Safe restricted graded-index material families
priorities.risk: high: expression/integration stability and invalid index domains
priorities.llmBurden: Named physical index profile, never arbitrary executable expression
priorities.acceptance: One bounded positive-index y-dependent profile tested against independent integrator; no silent numerical fallback.

numericalSafety: Native PhyDemo remains unmodified and selected optical objects may be exposed only after exact geometry/scope validation.
Every candidate requires strict no-invention authoring, actual native intersection and independent physics tests, stale/incomplete suppression, browser acceptance and qualified export.
Selection/relative counts are evidence of sampled capability needs; no JEE answer coverage or independent-model accuracy is estimated.
